name: XFUNDS 1-3 Month BOX ETF
desc: The fund generally invests its assets in a series of Box Spreads such that the weighted average maturity of the Box Spreads based upon expiration dates is less than 90 days. In order to achieve its objective, it will typically purchase a new Box Spread at the time any existing box spread expires or is sold or when Adviser and/or Sub-Adviser believes purchasing a new Box Spread would offer a favorable investment opportunity.
